name: FWC State Manatee Protection Zones in Florida
spatial_reference: WKID 102967 (Florida GDL Albers, NAD83 HARN/2011); request outSR=4326

zone_type_fields.MASTER_CL: summary class; 'NE' = No Entry (21 features), 'MP' = Motorboats Prohibited (6 features); other values are speed classes
zone_type_fields.CLASS1_68C/DATE1_68C: primary class and its dates, e.g. 'NE' 'NOV 15 - MAR 31', 'NEAY' 'JAN 1 - DEC 31' (No Entry all year)
zone_type_fields.CLASS2_68C/DATE2_68C: class for the rest of the year
